title: No file of the tools, skills or docs names the autopilot agent feature, and the Windows Autopilot product is untouched
goal: A sweep after the removals, scoped to the AGENT feature only: git grep over _tools, .claude, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and kb/_self finds no autopilot.py, autopilot_rehearse, kb-autopilot, KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER, bl_bounds or '--by autopilot' (outside kb/_self/_decisions.csv, the backlog item files and _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt, which keep history); the map.csv rows, README.md, plugin.md and maintaining.md skill tables name no removed file or skill; the selfdoc map and cohesion checks pass. The Windows/Intune Autopilot product is NEVER touched: kb/public/autopilot/*, the product lists of README.md, plugin.json and the kb-lookup skill, .gitattributes csdl entries and tests_allowlist.txt stay as they are. No new runbook section: one agent works one item at a time. Also delete kb/_self/reports/autopilot-digest.md and kb/_self/reports/autopilot-throwaway.md (the operator, 2026-10-04: remove the autopilot scratch file) and every reference to them.

run: import subprocess,sys; pat='autopilot[.]py|autopilot_rehearse|kb-autopilot|KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER|bl_bounds|--by autopilot'; r=subprocess.run(['git','grep','-n','-E',pat,'--','_tools','.claude','AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','kb/_self',':(exclude)kb/_self/_decisions.csv',':(exclude)kb/_self/backlog/',':(exclude)_tools/test_ids_dropped.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout+r.stderr); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==1 else 1)
import os,sys; sys.exit(1 if any(os.path.exists('kb/_self/reports/'+n) for n in ('autopilot-digest.md','autopilot-throwaway.md')) else 0)

gates.question: kbdecide.py digest writes kb/_self/reports/autopilot-digest.md by default (kbdecide.py DIGEST; digest --commit commits that tracked file, which test_backlog_record_clean.py and test_kbdecide.py rely on, and .claude/settings.json allows 'digest' and 'digest --commit'). With the report deleted, where does a bare 'kbdecide.py digest' write?
options: rename: the default becomes kb/_self/reports/decision-digest.md; digest and digest --commit behave as now, the tests and docs name the new path

no default file: a bare digest prints the digest to stdout, --out PATH writes a file, --commit refuses without --out; the tests, content-rules.md and tools.md say so, and the settings rule 'digest --commit' no longer has a use (the operator's to drop)
gates.recommendation: rename: the default becomes kb/_self/reports/decision-digest.md; digest and digest --commit behave as now, the tests and docs name the new path

notes: Runs last, after the other two removals land. Traps: tests copy fixed tool lists into temp repos and break when a module goes (TOOL_FILES in test_backlog_research.py, KS_TOOLS in test_bl_check.py, copied_tools in test_kbdecide.py, hand lists in test_backlog.py, test_backlog_authority.py, test_bl_stall.py, test_kblog.py): git grep each removed module over _tools/test_*.py before landing. A literal deleted path in an open item's touches is a check error (use globs); done refuses a changed file outside touches (widen on the work branch); an item check `selfdoc.py stale` fails on any stale doc (read it, name it in Self-Reviewed). Use focused `-n 1` test runs; land in the background with the longest timeout; no writes in the clone during land or sync; rm -rf is denied; trailer order Co-Authored-By, Self-Reviewed, KB-Work. The Windows/Intune Autopilot product is never touched (kb/public/**, product lists in README.md, plugin.json, kb-lookup skill, .gitattributes csdl lines, _tools/tests_allowlist.txt).
